Job Description: 
 Hadoop developer with in Hive and Json
 • Gather and process raw data at scale (including writing scripts, write SQL queries, etc.).
 • Hadoop development and implementation.
 • Process unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis, perform analysis and loading from disparate data sets.
 • Designing, building, installing, configuring and supporting Hadoop.
 • Experience in designing / parsing JSON documents.
 • Experience on process JSON file and loading data into Hadoop environment
 • Translate complex functional and technical requirements into detailed design.
 • Pre-processing using Hive.
 • Self-starter who works with minimal supervision
 • Strong Communication skills.


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6 Months 
 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE
